# Epicurean Stay

> Epicurean Stay connects guests with curated culinary and wellness hospitality experiences across major cities worldwide.

Epicurean Stay (EPS) is a platform founded by Luca Moretti, James Porter, and Elias Haddad that bridges travelers with authentic culinary and wellness hosts. The company operates across key markets including London, Toronto, New York, and other US, UK, and Canadian cities, leveraging AI-powered recommendations to deliver personalized gastronomic travel experiences.
